extension.summary: Synchronised Plex playback with friends in PM4K
extension.description: Watch Party synchronises Plex playback in PM4K across devices, so friends in different places can watch together. Start a watch party and invite people: playback starts, pauses and skips for everyone at the same time. Requires a Watch Party server and a connection code from its administrator.
extension.news: v0.3.14 - A skip made with Kodi's own controls (the keyboard or a remote on a PC) is shared from where it goes. Kodi still reported the old time at that moment, so the skip was shared from where you had been and the others never moved. - A skip of your own seconds after Watch Party moved your player is no longer mistaken for Watch Party's own move. - Watch Party starts itself again after an unexpected error, instead of stopping until Kodi restarts, and its errors no longer reach Kodi as script errors. - Small fixes: a record of invitations kept growing, and a question that could not be shown kept a timer running. v0.3.13 - An invitation left unanswered, or still on screen when Kodi closes, no longer counts as Not now, and no longer ends in "That invitation is no longer open" ten minutes later. - An invitation question closes by itself once the invitation is gone: joined on another of your devices, ended, or expired. - Invited again while the question is still open shows one question, not two. - Connecting again no longer makes Watch Party briefly think it is offline, which could drop a press of play or pause, and the old connection now ends at once. - A skip made with PM4K just after following someone else's skip is no longer mistaken for Watch Party's own jump: it is shared with everyone, instead of leaving this device seconds behind. - Season and episode stay together on one line. v0.3.12 - Questions and messages open in Watch Party's own window, in the style of its menu and the same on every skin: invitations, updates, leaving or ending a watch party, disconnecting and choosing a shortcut. Questions that cannot be undone start on Cancel. - While playback is paused, Watch Party's messages sit below the bar Kodi shows at the top instead of over it. - A long message no longer starts a line with a separator dot. v0.3.11 - A new menu: wider, the same on every skin, with where you stand at the top, each option's setting on the right and an explanation of the selected option at the bottom. Do not disturb switches right in the menu.

extension.description: Install this once. Kodi then keeps Watch Party up to date by itself.
